nombre_oficial.texto: The Plaza and the Facade of the Cathedral

frase_gancho.texto: A cathedral that took almost three centuries to finish.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: You begin in the plaza, in front of the Metropolitan Cathedral, the largest in Latin America. It was built on part of the sacred precinct of the Mexica, with stones from their temples, and construction lasted from fifteen seventy-three to eighteen thirteen. In these six stops you see it from the outside: what lies beneath the plaza’s ground, the main facade, the towers and their bells, why the styles change from one part to another, the Sagrario Metropolitano, and the stones of seventeen ninety.
